# ankra_dns_credential (Resource)

An external-dns webhook credential for a DNS zone you own, referenced by name from `ankra_organisation_custom_dns_zone`. The platform cannot change a stored credential, so any change replaces it. The counterpart of `ankra org dns credentials create`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ankra_dns_credential" "webhook" {
  name                 = "corporate-dns"
  webhook_provider_url = var.dns_webhook_url
}

variable "dns_webhook_url" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Credential name, unique among the organisation's credentials.
- `webhook_provider_url` (String, Sensitive) external-dns webhook endpoint, including its token. The platform never returns it, so a change made outside Terraform is not detected. Changing it replaces the credential.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier of the credential.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# DNS credentials are imported by name. The webhook URL cannot be read back;
# the first apply after the import records the configured one.
terraform import ankra_dns_credential.webhook corporate-dns
```
